sections.voiceover: Can you imagine British runner Josh Kerr sprinting a mile in 3:42.66 at London Stadium?
Did 60,000 spectators witness this historic world record run at the London Diamond League event?
Kerr shattered the 27-year-old world record previously held by Hicham El Guerrouj since July 1999.
The Brooks Beasts pacer, Brannon Kidder, aged 32, helped pace Josh Kerr to his world record mile attempt.
Watch Josh Kerr's historic run and learn how he achieved the world record at the London Diamond League.
